eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 6:55 PM on AUG 23, 2023 Effective until 6:55 PM AUG 24, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: All residents in the Singer area and north to include Fred Cloessner Road, Bob Cooley Road, Ira Cooley Road, John Bowman Road, and North end of Newlin Cemetery Road the Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office is issuing a mandatoryevacuation notice for this area. Fire conditions have intensified and now threatening residences in this area. Please cooperate with the deputies who will be coming door to door to help. Make preparations per CAP instructions
